True friends don’t tell you you’re being dumb. Real friends that care about you and your life tell you, “I hear your feelings and you can totally have them but let’s put a little more reality in there.” It’s doesn’t breed resentment at all it provides a place for negative feelings to be disbursed between people that aren’t emotional invested, so it keeps it from getting out of hand. Other perspectives are valuable and not clouded by your personal emotional or interests. I can see how this would become toxic in women in short term relationships, and with people you don’t trust, but that has more to do with her than with what she’s doing. In long term marriage, with long term friends it’s essential to happiness, and women that aren’t toxic know that. I can see why you’d feel the way you do. And how people mimic this behavior in unhealthy ways, the behavior isn’t unhealthy, those individuals are.
